title: Generative Retrieval under Real-Time Supply Constraints in Local Commerce
abstract: arXiv:2611.06323v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative retrieval predicts semantic identifiers for candidate entities. In local retail and food delivery, candidates must also be serviceable for a particular user at a particular time. Location, weather, and traffic reshape merchant and product supply, so a catalog-valid identifier may be infeasible for the current request. Post-generation filtering removes such candidates only after beam capacity and inference computation have been spent. We study retrieval over an explicitly materialized, request-time supply snapshot, where short output sequences leave little opportunity to amortize online constraint preparation. Our RTP-LLM pipeline compiles eligible residual-quantization identifiers into a compressed sparse row prefix index, overlaps CPU compilation with model prefill, and shares the uploaded index across beams. translated_title: 本地商业中实时供给约束下的生成式检索
translated_abstract: 生成式检索为候选实体预测语义标识符。在本地零售和外卖配送场景中，候选还必须在特定时间对特定用户是可服务的。位置、天气和交通会不断重塑商家与商品供给，因此目录中有效的标识符对当前请求而言可能是不可行的。生成后过滤方式只有在beam容量和推理计算已经消耗之后才会移除这类候选。我们研究了在显式物化的、请求时刻供给快照上的检索问题，此时较短的输出序列几乎没有机会来摊销在线约束准备的开销。我们的RTP-LLM流水线将合格的残差量化标识符编译为压缩稀疏行前缀索引，将CPU编译与模型预填充阶段重叠执行，并在多个beam之间共享上传的索引。合法的扩展保留原始模型的对数概率，约束状态则跟随被选中的beam父节点。我们……
tldr: 该论文提出RTP-LLM流水线，通过将合格的残差量化语义标识符预先编译为压缩稀疏行前缀索引、与模型预填充并行执行CPU编译并在beam间共享，使生成式检索能在解码过程中直接满足本地商业的实时供给约束，避免对不可行候选浪费beam容量和推理计算。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RTP-LLM, a pipeline that enforces real-time supply constraints during beam-search generative retrieval in local commerce by compiling eligible residual-quantization identifiers into a compressed sparse row prefix index built in parallel with model prefill and shared across beams, avoiding wasted beam capacity and inference computation on infeasible candidates.
